cards.ex: I had a total senior moment and forgot where I parked the car!
cards.exUz: Menda xotira pand berdi va mashinani qayerga qo'yganimni unutdim!
cards.uzDef: Kattalardagi unutuvchanlik, qisqa muddatli xotira yo'qolishi.

cards.ex: He's starting to lose his marbles; he keeps repeating himself.
cards.exUz: U aqlini yo'qota boshlayapti; u o'zini takrorlayapti.

cards.ex: My grandma is getting on in years, but she's still very active.
cards.exUz: Mening buvim yoshi o'tib boryapti, lekin u hali ham juda faol.

cards.ex: Looking through these old photos is quite a trip down memory lane.
cards.exUz: Bu eski rasmlarni ko'rib chiqish - xotiralar sayohati.

cards.ex: She still has a youthful glow, even in her 50s.
cards.exUz: U 50 yoshda bo'lsa ham, hali ham yoshlik jilvasiga ega.
cards.uzDef: Yoshlikka xos nur, sog'lom va yosh ko'rinish.

cards.ex: Exercise helps keep the cogs in your memory turning efficiently.
cards.exUz: Mashq xotira mexanizmlarini samarali ishlashiga yordam beradi.

cards.ex: She's determined to age gracefully and embrace the changes.
cards.exUz: U chiroyli qarishga va o'zgarishlarni qabul qilishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Tabiiy va chiroyli ravishda qarilikka erishish.

cards.ex: I had a memory lapse and couldn't remember her name.
cards.exUz: Menda xotira uzilishi bo'ldi va uning ismini eslay olmadim.
cards.uzDef: Qisqa muddatli xotira yo'qolishi, esdan chiqish.

cards.ex: They're enjoying their golden years, traveling the world.
cards.exUz: Ular o'zlarining oltin davrlaridan zavqlanishmoqda, dunyo bo'ylab sayohat qilishmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Pensiada o'tadigan baxtli yillar, qarilik davri.

cards.ex: I remember the day we met like it was yesterday.
cards.exUz: Biz uchrashgan kunni kechagidek eslayman.
cards.uzDef: Voqeani yaqinda sodir bo'lgandek aniq eslash.

cards.ex: Her long-term memory is excellent; she remembers everything.
cards.exUz: Uning uzoq muddatli xotirasi juda yaxshi; u hamma narsani eslaydi.

cards.ex: His short-term memory isn't great; he forgets things easily.
cards.exUz: Uning qisqa muddatli xotirasi yaxshi emas; u narsalarni osonlik bilan unutadi.

cards.ex: Puzzles and games can help you hone your memory.
cards.exUz: Boshqotirmalar va o'yinlar xotirani charxlashga yordam beradi.

cards.ex: I have fading memories of my childhood.
cards.exUz: Mening bolaligim haqidagi xotiralarim so'nayapti.

cards.ex: I remember that day as clear as a bell.
cards.exUz: Men o'sha kunni juda aniq eslayman.

cards.ex: Childhood memories are often the most vivid.
cards.exUz: Bolalik xotiralari ko'pincha eng yorqin bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Bolalik davrida sodir bo'lgan voqealar haqidagi xotiralar.

cards.ex: If memory serves me right, we met at a party.
cards.exUz: Agar xotiram pand bermasa, biz ziyofatda uchrashganmiz.
cards.uzDef: Agar xotiram adashmasa, agar to'g'ri eslasam.

cards.ex: I completely blanked out during the exam.
cards.exUz: Imtihon paytida men butunlay esdan chiqardim.
cards.uzDef: Birdaniga unutib qo'ymoq, hech narsani eslay olmaslik.

cards.ex: I have a mind like a sieve; I can't remember anything!
cards.exUz: Mening miyam teshik; men hech narsani eslay olmayman!
cards.uzDef: Tezda unutadigan odam, yomon xotiraga ega odam.

cards.ex: They're always searching for the fountain of youth.
cards.exUz: Ular doimo yoshlik bulog'ini qidirishadi.

cards.ex: He's in his dotage and needs constant care.
cards.exUz: U qarilikning zaiflik davrida va doimiy parvarishga muhtoj.
cards.uzDef: Qarilikning zaiflashgan holatida, aqli zaiflik davrida.

cards.ex: We often reminisce about our college days.
cards.exUz: Biz ko'pincha kollej kunlarimizni eslaymiz.

cards.ex: My grandfather is in his second childhood.
cards.exUz: Mening bobom ikkinchi bolaligida.

cards.ex: I have a vivid memory of our first meeting.
cards.exUz: Menda birinchi uchrashuvimiz haqida yorqin xotira bor.
cards.uzDef: Yaxshi esda qolgan, aniq va ta'sirchan xotira.

cards.ex: I know I've met her before, but she's hard to place.
cards.exUz: Men uni avval ko'rganman, lekin eslay olmayapman.

cards.ex: Crosswords help maintain mental agility.
cards.exUz: Krossvordlar aqliy chaqqonlikni saqlashga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Tez fikrlash, muammolarni oson hal qilish qobiliyati.

cards.ex: That movie is a classic coming-of-age story.
cards.exUz: Bu film voyaga yetish haqida klassik hikoya.

cards.ex: That song always triggers a memory of my childhood.
cards.exUz: Bu qo'shiq doimo mening bolaligim haqidagi xotirani qo'zg'atadi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa xotirani eslatmoq, xotirani faollashtirmoq.

cards.ex: He's past his prime as a football player.
cards.exUz: U futbolchi sifatida o'z davrini o'tkazib bo'lgan.

cards.ex: She has a memory like an elephant; she never forgets a face.
cards.exUz: U fil xotirasiga ega; u hech qachon yuzni unutmaydi.
